I decided to enroll my dog ​​in this daycare for obedience training.

The staff are all very kind and attentive, and my dog ​​seems to look forward to going.

Spending time with other dogs at the daycare seems to have helped her develop social skills. There have also been positive changes in her behavior at home; she's calmer than before, and walks are much easier.

They pay close attention to my dog ​​and carefully inform me about her day and any concerns they have, which gives me great peace of mind.

This is a wonderful daycare that I feel confident entrusting my dog ​​to in the future.

We've been sending our puppy here since it was a puppy. Since we live in the city, many kindergartens are small, but we chose this one because it's spacious and seems like a good place for puppies to run around.

It's great that they have plenty of room to run and that each puppy has a dedicated teacher! They provide proper training, and most importantly, they even point out things about the puppy's body that we might not have noticed ourselves. We feel so at ease leaving our puppy here, and it's been a huge help. We look forward to continuing to use their services.

I just started sending my two rescue dogs, who became part of my family at the end of last year, to the school.
I'm really glad I chose the Meguro school because they gave me advice on how I should interact with them as an owner, tailored to each dog, and I was able to meet a trustworthy trainer.

I learned that it's precisely because I want my dog ​​to be well-raised that I pay the money and want support for the growth of both the owner and the dog, and that it's the trainer, not the school, that I should be entrusting my dog ​​to.
I'll be patient and try out what I learned at home.
